info_ir_repeat:
Repeat count (1–20), overriding any repeat value in the code.

HEX: Overrides the repeat field; protocol-specific repeat behavior is handled automatically.

PRONTO: Repeats the 2nd burst pair sequence (4th number in the PRONTO code); ignored if the code has no repeat sequence.
info_ir_hold:
Minimum duration in ms to send the IR code, simulating a long button press.

Overrides repeat if set.

The signal always completes its final IR message, so the actual send time may be slightly longer.
info_ir_repeat_mode:
Activate IR repeat mode. Press and hold the Start Repeat button to continuously send the IR code.

Requires Repeat value > 0 with a matching repeat interval to renew the IR signal.
info_ir_periodic: Interval in ms to repeatedly send the IR code while the Send button is held.
info_ir_learn_text: The infrared receiver is at the top of the dock.
info_port_active: Detected peripheral if in AUTO mode.
info_port_location: From the back, left to right: Ethernet — Port 1 — Port 2 — USB-C.
info_buffering:
Chunk: data is forwarded in chunks after a short timeout.
Line: data is forwarded line by line; the end of the line is indicated by the terminating character.
info_terminator:
Line end terminating character in hex notation.
Line feed: 0x0A, Carriage return: 0x0D
info_line_timeout: Timeout in ms for forwarding received data if no terminating character is detected.
